articles.title: Casablanca Port Plan Targets Faster Freight Turnaround
articles.summary: A proposed logistics upgrade would expand digital cargo processing and improve links between the port and inland distribution hubs. Officials say the next step is a public review of the project timeline and its expected impact on local businesses.

articles.title: Rabat Opens Consultation on Expanded Civic Services
articles.summary: The city is inviting residents to comment on a proposed package of neighborhood service improvements. Organizers say feedback sessions will focus on access, delivery priorities, and how progress should be reported.

articles.title: Marrakech Youth Sports Program Adds Community Facilities
articles.summary: A new community sports initiative plans to add training sessions and shared facilities for young athletes across several districts. Local clubs will help shape the schedule, with organizers emphasizing broad participation and access for girls and boys.

articles.title: Tangier Issues Coastal Weather Advisory for Small Craft
articles.summary: Marine services are advising small boats to check local conditions before heading out as unsettled weather is forecast along parts of the northern coast. Residents are encouraged to follow official updates and take care near exposed shorelines.

articles.title: Fluidra Opens New Production Plant at Tanger Automotive City
articles.summary: Fluidra has opened a new production facility at Tanger Automotive City after converting the former Siemens Gamesa site. The 38,610-square-metre plant makes polyester filters and plastic components, with a reported investment of MAD 120 million and 496 jobs created.

articles.title: FIFA Plans Inspection Visit to Tangier's 2030 World Cup Preparations
articles.summary: FIFA inspectors are scheduled to visit Tangier on 28 November to review the city's preparations for the 2030 World Cup. The planned tour includes the Grand Stade, training facilities, hotels, the airport and the proposed fan-zone area.

articles.title: Planned Tangier–Airport Rail Link Would Pass Through Mghogha Industrial Zone
articles.summary: A proposed 22.5-kilometre rail link would connect Tangier Ville station with Ibn Battouta Airport and include a stop in Mghogha. The planned route could affect industrial properties in the zone while aiming to improve rail access to the airport.

articles.title: Authorities Seize Eight Kilograms of Cocaine at Tangier Ville Port
articles.summary: Police and customs officers at Tangier Ville Port intercepted a passenger arriving from Tarifa with eight kilograms of cocaine concealed in his vehicle. The suspect was detained as investigators examine possible local and cross-border links.

articles.title: Collision Damages Five Vehicles in Tangier's Place Toros Area
articles.summary: A collision in Tangier's Place Toros area damaged five vehicles after one car struck four parked cars, with no physical injuries reported. Police opened an investigation and detained the two occupants while checking reports that alcohol may have been involved.

articles.title: Sidi Aayad Scheduled for MA-INDAR Public Alert System Test
articles.summary: Sidi Aayad in Midelt Province is scheduled to take part in a field test of Morocco's MA-INDAR public mobile-alert system on 24 November from 11:00 to 12:00. Authorities say the exercise is technical only and does not indicate a real emergency.

articles.title: Azemmour Prepares for MA-INDAR Public Alert System Field Test
articles.summary: Azemmour is scheduled to test the MA-INDAR public mobile-alert system on 24 November, following completion of local preparations. The exercise will check SMS and cell-broadcast delivery and is a technical test, not a warning of an actual threat.

articles.title: El Al to Resume Direct Tel Aviv–Marrakech Flights in December
articles.summary: El Al announced that it will resume direct Tel Aviv–Marrakech flights on 21 December 2026, operating twice weekly on Mondays and Wednesdays. The airline said the relaunch follows the required approvals and a postponement from its earlier November plan.

articles.title: Morocco's Women's National Team to Begin Training Camp in Salé
articles.summary: Morocco's senior women's national team is due to begin a training camp at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Salé on 24 November. The 28-player gathering will prepare for friendly matches against Venezuela and France in early December.
articles.city: Complexe Mohammed VI de Football, Maâmora, Salé

articles.title: Nine Road Projects Planned to Improve Access to Nador West Med
articles.summary: Nine road projects with a combined budget of about MAD 2.98 billion have been programmed to improve links around Nador West Med. The plan includes road widening, rehabilitation, a port ring road and connections to Nador and nearby provinces.
articles.city: Nador West Med Port, Iaazzanene, Nador Province

articles.title: Oujda University Students Organize Humanitarian Convoy to Tafoughalt
articles.summary: Students from Mohammed First University's National School of Commerce and Management organized a humanitarian convoy to Douar Ouled Hamad in Tafoughalt on 22 November. Volunteers distributed food baskets, clothing and school supplies and helped rehabilitate school spaces.

articles.title: Tiznit Marks 69th Anniversary of the Aït Baâmrane Uprising
articles.summary: Tiznit hosted a meeting marking the 69th anniversary of the Aït Baâmrane tribes' uprising, with former resistance figures and local representatives in attendance. The gathering highlighted regional history and honoured several former resistance members.

articles.title: Gendarmerie Operation in Bhalil Leads to Major Cannabis Seizure
articles.summary: Gendarmerie officers carried out an operation in the Bhalil area of Sefrou Province and arrested a suspect allegedly carrying around 200 kilograms of cannabis and 11 kilograms of hashish. The case was referred for judicial investigation.

articles.title: Suspected Drug Trafficker Arrested in Central Taddart
articles.summary: Gendarmerie officers arrested a man in his twenties in central Taddart on suspicion of drug trafficking. Officers reported seizing a motorcycle, hashish and cash, and the investigation is continuing under the prosecutor's supervision.

articles.title: Cyclist Seriously Injured in Road Incident Near Taddart
articles.summary: A cyclist was seriously injured in a road incident in the Taddart area and was taken to the provincial hospital in Guercif. Gendarmerie officers are investigating the circumstances, including reports that the vehicle involved left the scene.

articles.title: Dakhla Global Summit Sets Out Ten Commitments for African Health Sovereignty
articles.summary: The second Dakhla Global Summit concluded with a declaration setting out ten commitments to strengthen African health sovereignty, including better access to care, local medicine production and health research. Participants also called for stronger health-data governance, environmental protection and more resilient health systems.

articles.title: Safi's Bab Chaaba Area to Receive New Artisan Sales Spaces
articles.summary: Safi's Bab Chaaba area is receiving new sales spaces for artisans and pottery sellers as part of a local upgrade program. The wider municipal package also includes improvements to public spaces and sports facilities elsewhere in the city.

articles.title: Police Arrest Two Suspects and Seize Psychotropic Tablets in Témara
articles.summary: Police in Témara's fifth district arrested two people suspected of involvement in criminal activity and seized psychotropic tablets and bladed weapons. The operation forms part of local enforcement against drug distribution and related offences.

articles.title: Al Omrane Presents New Affordable Housing Offer in Oujda
articles.summary: Al Omrane has presented new apartments at the Al Jorf Al Akhdar Residence, phases 2 and 3, in Oujda, with advertised prices starting at MAD 220,000. The project is intended to broaden the city's residential supply with landscaped shared spaces and pedestrian access.

articles.title: Oulad Yekhlef Association Renews Its Leadership in Kariat Arkmane
articles.summary: The Oulad Yekhlef association in Kariat Arkmane, Nador Province, renewed Abdelwahed Boutkhrit's mandate as president and formed its new executive bureau. The association says the new team will continue local social initiatives and community programs.
